searchText: <@!304360319948685312> surely there will be, but the reason I'm not too concerned about it is that it is extremely easy to figure out. You just need to calculate the `gasUsed` * `baseFeePerGas` in each block to get it, and given that information is in the block header, it will be very accessible. i've mentioned it in the dev channel before but it'd be really great to keep track of the incoming/included fraction of transactions that were originally sent in the pre-1559 format, to assess wallet and ecosystem adoption Is there a way to know that by looking on-chain? Yes. Block bodies have it. But not the “incoming” part. It’d be interesting to check how many legacy transactions are received (roughly) but aren’t eventually included
